newsitem.title: THAILAND: Srithai sees 1997 revenue rising 10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Srithai sees 1997 revenue rising 10 pct.

text.p: Srithai Superware Plc, Thailand's largest manufacturer and distributor of plastic and melamine, expects its revenue in 1997 to rise by 10 percent to 4.0 billion baht ($154 million).
"The company's revenue will reach 4.0 billion this year or grow by 10 percent," Sanan Ang-ubolkul, the firm's president told Reuters in an interview.
Srithai's revenue in 1996 totalled 3.68 billion baht compared with 3.35 billion in the previous year.
Srithai's revenue rise this year will be supported by growing demand for its plastic and melamine products in provinces and overseas markets, Sanan said.
"Domestic demand for our products remain strong especially in provincial markets. Our U.S. and Japan export markets are also expected to grow significantly," Sanan said.
